name: Duryea
role: Surveyor working along the Little Missouri, 1884
bio: Duryea led a surveying party down the Little Missouri in 1884. The paper calls him both a Northern Pacific surveyor and a member of the government surveying party.

moments.label: His surveying party worked down the river
